text:
BIG-IP LTM v13.1.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 13.1.0
ACCESS::flowid
- set/get the flow id for
SSL Orchestrator using APM logging framework
ACCESS::oauth
- returns a JSON Web
Signature token
ANTIFRAUD::alert_origin
-
returns the origin of the alert, e.g. clientside, serverside or
secure alert cookie.
BOTDEFENSE::client_type
-
returns the type of the client that sent the request
FTP::enable
- enables FTP protocol handler
for FTP message processing
IMAP::activation_mode
- gets or
sets the activation mode for IMAP STARTTLS
IMAP::disable
- disables IMAP protocol
handler for IMAP message processing
IMAP::enable
- enables IMAP protocol
handler for IMAP message processing
MQTT::message
- returns the full content
of the MQTT message
MR::equivalent_transport
-
gets or sets the transport that is usable as an equivalent
transport
MR::ignore_peer_port
- sets or
resets the ignore_peer_port mode of the current connection
NSH::chain
- sets the chain for flow
NSH::mocksf
- set option to mock SF functionality for NSH
POP3::activation_mode
- gets or
sets the activation mode for POP3 STARTTLS
POP3::disable
- disable STARTTLS for POP3
POP3::enable
- enable STARTTLS for POP3
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION::disable
- disables inspection of the flow
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION::id
-
provides inspection match result
SMTPS::activation_mode
- gets or
sets the activation mode for SMTPS
TCP::push_flag
- used to set/get the
PUSH flag mode of a TCP connection
Commands Updated in BIG-IP LTM 13.1.0
MR::message
- returns or sets details in
the message routing table
MR::peer
- defines a peer to use for routing a
message to
RADIUS::avp
- Return or add/change/remove
RADIUS av pairs
SDP::field
- Returns the value in a given
SDP field
SIP::persist
- returns (or replaces) the
persistence key being used for the current message
SSL::forward_proxy
- sets the SSL
forward proxy bypass feature to bypass or intercept.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 13.1.0
CLIENTSSL_PASSTHROUGH
- Triggered
when the SSL receive the plaintext data and enter the passthrough
mode
PROTOCOL_INSPECTION_MATCH
-
Triggered when protocol inspection is matched for this flow
